snippet.title: Mugwump (1973) | Hunt the Mugwump | 013
snippet.description:
A hide-and-seek game where you hunt for Mugwumps in a 10x10 grid. The game gives you clues as to the Mugwumps' whereabouts. Originally created as an educational game designed to teach the Cartesian co-ordinate system, it was modified into its current form by Bob Albrecht of People's Computer Company.

This game and many other early text-based games can be downloaded and played through Vintage BASIC: http://vintage-basic.net/index.html

Want to learn more? Read about it here: https://obsessivegamingchronology.blogspot.com/2025/09/013-mugwump.html
